description.value: Soul Cup Cafe is a cafe specializing in bubble tea, coffee, and fresh juices located on Ridgeway Avenue. It serves as a neighbourhood spot for cold and hot drinks in the Coquitlam area. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a useful stop for a refreshing drink.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL resolves to Soul Cup Cafe's Instagram profile, but Instagram's login wall prevented any business-specific content from loading — all fetched pages are generic Instagram UI (login, terms, explore). All amenity fields therefore default to null. OSM tags confirm a bubble tea/coffee/juice cafe at 1071 Ridgeway Avenue with postal code V3J 1S6, which is a Coquitlam postal code, not North Vancouver as listed in the community field — a notable discrepancy worth flagging.
